bio: The Kabuki Group’s latest culinary venture, in the heart of the city’s Salamanca district, remains faithful to its roots, inviting guests to explore dishes with their essence in Japanese cuisine but with an Iberian touch – a concept which has been synonymous with the Kabuki brand over the years and its desire to transport guests back to Japan. In this spacious setting, with its restrained lighting and meticulous decor, the cuisine is centred on a tasting menu complemented by an extensive cocktail menu....
